title: senderMsgId derived from MIMI MessageId (R1)
description: JMAP senderMsgId is derived deterministically from the MIMI MessageId so references (replyTo, threadRootId, reactions) resolve identically on every device without a shared table: ULID time = hub-accepted timestamp in ms; 80-bit randomness = MessageId octets 1..10. Collision ~2^-40 per same-ms pair (estimated). Source: agora/notes/mimi-vs-jmap-chat.md R1/A3.
notes: 2026-10-18 (Mark): KEEP this recipe (ULID time = hub-accepted timestamp + octets 1..10). draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 currently uses the 16 octets after the algorithm octet and rejects the timestamp recipe; Mark chose to keep .10 and change the draft instead.
